title: Solved Example
problem: A sarcomere is 2.4 µm long at rest. During contraction each I-band shortens by 0.2 µm. What is the new sarcomere length?
answer: The A-band stays constant; only the I-bands shorten.
steps: Each sarcomere has two half I-bands, so total shortening = 2 × 0.2 µm = 0.4 µm
